findings.evidence: Owner leave returned 200 and closed the lobby; a later leave returned 409 MATCH_LOBBY_NOT_MUTABLE; later presence returned 403.

Attempt start and host allocation returned 200, then GET /v1/p2p-rooms/{room_id} returned 410 ONLINE_P2P_ROOM_RETIRED before host completion; persisted attempt ended P2P_AUTHORITY_LAUNCH_FAILED with no payload/world/endpoint/connection proof.

source_findings.lines: Leave owner transition and non-open rejection
failure code is client supplied; no lower-level native error is created by Backend

constraints: No source or remote state was modified for the diagnosis receipt.
No raw logs, access tokens, Steam IDs, grant material, or request IDs are included.
The two ended attempts are negative evidence only and were not revived.
implementation_followup: Authoritative scoped transport endpoints and current frozen-roster connection gate are implemented separately in the working tree; they require focused tests and CI before any real multiplayer PASS claim.
